enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.hint: Master switch. Off = no events emitted, all commands refused.

botUserId.name: Bot user ID
botUserId.hint: Foundry user id of the AI GM bot account (preferred leader). Set it in Configure AI GM.

botUserName.name: Bot user name prefix
botUserName.hint: Fallback if no bot user is picked: first GM whose name starts with this. Blank = off.

heartbeatTimeoutMs.name: Leader timeout (ms)
heartbeatTimeoutMs.hint: Default 45000; a human GM takes over only after this.

keywords.name: Wake keywords
keywords.hint: Comma-separated words that wake the GM.

hpPath.name: HP data path
hpPath.hint: Actor data path for HP (Pirate Borg: system.hp.value).

alwaysVoiceUsers.name: Always-voice users
alwaysVoiceUsers.hint: Comma-separated user names who always get voice replies.

unpauseOnStart.name: Unpause on 'start'
unpauseOnStart.hint: Typing 'start' in chat unpauses the game.

debounceMs.name: Debounce (ms)
debounceMs.hint: Send a chat burst after this much quiet. One bot wake per burst.

maxWaitMs.name: Max wait (ms)
maxWaitMs.hint: Never hold the first event longer than this (default 3500 ms).

wakeOn.name: Wake on
wakeOn.hint: Comma list: mention, whisper, keyword, question, ic (any in-character line).

ignorePlainRolls.name: Ignore plain rolls
ignorePlainRolls.hint: Rolls without a question don't wake the bot.

ignoreUsers.name: Ignore users
ignoreUsers.hint: Comma list of user names or ids that never wake the bot.

minChars.name: Min characters
minChars.hint: Shorter messages don't wake the bot (mentions and whispers still do).

localCommands.name: Local commands
localCommands.hint: Handle !roll, !music, !scene, !hp, !luck in Foundry with no bot call.

maxTextChars.name: Max text per event
maxTextChars.hint: Longer chat is trimmed in the payload.

ttsMinChars.name: TTS min characters
ttsMinChars.hint: Replies shorter than this are posted as text (no TTS). 0 = off.

uploadsEnabled.name: Allow bot uploads
uploadsEnabled.hint: Let the AI GM upload images, audio and text into the ai-gm-uploads folder. GM-only.

uploadMaxMB.name: Upload size limit (MB)
uploadMaxMB.hint: Largest file the AI GM may upload.

speakerAlias.name: Speaker alias
speakerAlias.hint: Name shown on cards the module posts (roll requests, turn prompts, rest).

rollRequestTimeoutMs.name: Roll request timeout (ms)
rollRequestTimeoutMs.hint: After this, a requested roll shows a GM-only 'roll for them' button and the bot gets a rollTimeout event.

turnPrompts.name: Combat turn prompts
turnPrompts.hint: Post who is up on each turn change and notify the owning player. Handled in Foundry, no bot wake.

turnWake.name: Wake bot on turns
turnWake.hint: Also send turn changes to the bot (costs a wake per turn).

turnVoiceUsers.name: Voiced turn prompts for
turnVoiceUsers.hint: Comma-separated user names or ids. Those players hear their turn prompt: a cached bot clip if one exists, else browser speech.

sessionLog.name: Session log
sessionLog.hint: Log HP changes, deaths, items, resources and combat to the GM-only journal 'AI GM Session Log'.

rollRequestExpireMs.name: Roll request expiry after timeout (ms)
rollRequestExpireMs.hint: How long after the timeout a roll card can still be answered (GM fallback window). After that it is marked Expired.

rollAnswerNote.name: Roll answer note
rollAnswerNote.hint: Post a small chat line saying which roll card a roll answered.

ramUsesArmor.name: Ram uses target armour (house rule)
ramUsesArmor.hint: Off (default) matches the Pirate Borg system: a ram rolls the target's armour but does not subtract it. On subtracts the armour roll from ram damage.

thinkingIndicator.name: "GM is thinking…" indicator
thinkingIndicator.hint: Show every client a small notice (bottom right, not in chat) after a player message or roll is sent to the bot, until the bot replies.

thinkingTimeoutMs.name: Thinking indicator timeout (ms)
thinkingTimeoutMs.hint: Hide the indicator after this long if the bot has not replied. 0 = only hide on reply.

combatEvents.name: Send combat start/end
combatEvents.hint: Send the bot an immediate event when combat starts or ends, so it can stay awake during fights.

pushToTalk.name: Push-to-talk (this browser)
pushToTalk.hint: Hold the key or the mic button to speak; your words are posted as your chat message. Uses your browser's speech recognition (Chrome/Edge).

pushToTalkKey.name: Push-to-talk key
pushToTalkKey.hint: KeyboardEvent code or key, e.g. Backquote, KeyV, F2. Ignored while typing in a text box.

aiPaused.name: Pause the AI GM
aiPaused.hint: When on, player chat is not sent to the AI GM. Use the in-game AI GM panel to pause or resume.

ptt.unavailable: Push-to-talk needs a browser with speech recognition (Chrome or Edge). It is turned off here.
ptt.denied: Microphone access was blocked. Allow the mic for this site to use push-to-talk.

config.botUser: Bot GM user (preferred leader, runs commands)
config.secretHint: Write-only here. World settings are readable by scripts of any logged-in user, so prefer the relay (env-only secret) for shared worlds.
